name: Pleasure/Displeasure
arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ)) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)).

metadata.reference: Ibën Sunnij në “Amel el-Jevmi ve Lejleh” dhe Hakimi, i cili e ka vërtetuar 1/499. Gjithashtu shejh Albani e ka autentifikuar në “Sahih el-Xhamiu” 4/201.

transliterations.latin: Elhamdulil-lahil-ledhi bi ni’ëmetihi tetimmus-salihat\n\nElhamdulil-lahi ala kul-li hal

translations.albanian: Falënderimi i qoftë Allahut, i Cili me begatinë e Tij i plotëson punët e mira.\n\nFalënderimi i takon Allahut për çdo gjendje.
translations.english: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
translations.indonesian: Rasulullah Shallallahu'alaihi wasallam apabila ada sesuatu yang menyenangkan, beliau membaca:
